rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for a large amount or quantity.

example.english: The farm produced abundantly this year; there’ll still be plenty left after feeding the whole village for months.
example.traditional: 今年個農場收成好多，成條村食幾個月都仲有剩。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 go3 nung4 coeng4 sau1 sing4 hou2 do1 sing4 tiu4 cyun1 sik6 gei2 go3 jyut6 dou1 zung6 jau5 sing6

rows.note: Use this before an adjective when “abundantly” means extremely or very much.

example.english: These fish balls are abundantly spicy; I can’t handle even one.
example.traditional: 呢碗辣魚蛋好辣，食一粒已經頂唔順。
example.jyutping: ne1 wun2 laat6 jyu4 daan2 hou2 laat6 sik6 jat1 nap1 ji5 ging1 ding2 m4 seon6
